commit.message:
feat(app,ui): rename and reorder operations and retain project filenames

Fixes #45
docs(changelog): record operation order and project filename updates
Merge upstream main into operation branch
feat(ui): collapse and expand browser sections

feat(ui): add viewport visibility controls and work offset labels

Rename the project toolbar action to Open. Add browser visibility toggles for stock and work offsets, and hide operation overlays with their paths. Correct moved work offset axis label positions.

feat(ui): copy operations and control toolpath visibility

Add undoable operation paste, browser context menu actions, and a Close control for the operation editor. Make the browser checkbox and viewport controls show or hide every operation path.

fix(ui): stabilize operation editing and playback

Follow operation order during simulation and toolpath display. Add editor close actions and guard empty GPU buffer slices. Confirm operation type changes and show the saved type in the editor. Update UI snapshots and regression coverage.
chore: merge current main into operation workflow branch

fix(ui): satisfy browser interaction lint checks

BREAKING CHANGE: Projects saved with the v50 format cannot be opened by older Camcraft builds.
